name: surfaceTuning
meaning: per-surface tuning, index Wolf.surface (0 normal, 1 ice), 0x12 bytes each; [4..8] read by Wolf_SurfaceVelocity, [8] = gravity rate (Wolf_LeapStep 0x488f3b, Wolf_FallStep 0x48964d pass it to Wolf_ApplyGravity); values set by Wolf_InitMoveConfig 0x4880f2

name: surfaceTuningU
meaning: the same tuning words read unsigned: Wolf::StateMachine's and Wolf::Update's row pointer (movzx reads)

name: states
meaning: state descriptor table, index Wolf.state (0x488e86: mov edx,[bank+0x24]; lea eax,[edx+8*state])

name: profiles
meaning: movement profile tables, index Wolf.surface (0x488ebb: add ecx,[bank+4*surface+0x28])

name: params
meaning: nine more tuning words written by Wolf_InitMoveConfig 0x488136-0x48817e; +0x3E/+0x40 are the run-timer thresholds 0x199/0xC00
